lists.title: Reports
lists.intro: Every list shows the records you may see, with the same permissions as the module's own page. Download a list as CSV to work on it in a spreadsheet.
lists.none: There is no list you can see in this project.
lists.shown: The first {{shown}} of {{count}} records are shown; the CSV file has all of them (at most {{max}}).
lists.capped: Only the first {{max}} records are listed.
lists.enterprise: Report dashboards (charts, templates, AI, sharing, versions) come with SiteKeep Enterprise (Platform module).

spec.title: Specification Analysis
spec.intro: Draft submittal registers extracted from specification PDFs. For a new analysis, pick a PDF from + Start Specification Analysis above or press Extract Submittal Register from Specification in the Title Block section of the file panel in Documents.

specView.importHint: Creates submittal items from the rows that are not excluded
specView.jsonHint: For transfer to the submittals module
specView.aiClassifyHint: Unclassified items are classified with the AI model; item edits are reset.
specView.rebuildHint: Reads the specification again; item edits are reset.
